about: Leans and rules for the tiers, each under forward test. Evidence policy (2026-11-09): a LEAN (40+ decision pairs, 80%+ of slate resamples one way) is ADOPTED, used as a tiebreak or default, only if it holds in both windows, was listed as a candidate before testing, or hit the RULE numbers (80+ pairs, a 90% range clear of zero) and waits on its check (14 slates: 9 to choose on, 5 to check, plus the drop-one-player test); every other lean is a CANDIDATE, forward-tested only. At step 4 chance alone would give about 27 leans of the 67 testable cells; 30 appeared. Anything adopted is dropped if it flips direction over its 14 forward nights. Sources: analysis/nba/report/tier_grade.md, q_lane.md, scripts/nba_take_types.py.

adopted.statement: AM T5: the Tiers button's order is the default; your moves off it are logged as takes and graded.
adopted.evidence: Holds against ADP in both windows: your board against ADP in T5, AM primary -3.1 per pair (364 pairs, LEAN with the RULE numbers, check pending), PM -2.4 (728 pairs, RULE). Takes against the button, AM primary: -3.3 per take (285 pairs, 80% range -4.8 to -1.6).
adopted.drop_if: AM T5 takes against the button turn positive over the 14 forward nights

adopted.statement: VALUE-flagged players go first in their tier (the button already sorts them there) in the middle and T5, both windows.
adopted.evidence: VALUE beat its pair partners: middle AM +2.5 (167 pairs), PM +2.7 (253); T4 AM +4.1 (73), PM +1.9 (102); T5 AM +4.5 (341, RULE numbers, check pending), PM +3.5 (512). Points per pair, swap rule.
adopted.drop_if: VALUE stops beating its partners in either window over the 14 forward nights

adopted.statement: PM window: a Questionable player is ordered two tiers back (the button's NBA_PM_Q_PUSH; the chip shows the tier he's ordered in).
adopted.evidence: Against the button's order on decision pairs involving him: +4.9 per pair (103 pairs, 80% range +2.1 to +8.4), RULE numbers, check pending. Back one tier +0.8 (66, no lean); ranking on X -0.7 (374, no lean).
adopted.drop_if: it flips over the 14 forward nights, or fails the check on the last 5 slates once there are 14

adopted.statement: AM window: no push for a Questionable player; keep the button's order (a scratch is swapped, and the swap scores about like a T3/T4 player).
adopted.evidence: No variant beat the button: back one tier -1.1 (89 pairs), back two +0.8 (119), rank on X -1.8 (262); none a lean. Swaps average about 33 points (swap value S about right, +1.0).
adopted.drop_if: a push variant reaches a lean over the 14 forward nights

adopted.statement: PM T5: keep making beneficiary picks (raising a player whose teammate is tagged or out).
adopted.evidence: PM T5 takes by type: beneficiary picks +3.5 per take (96 pairs, 61% right, 80% range +0.1 to +6.8).
adopted.basis: listed as a candidate before testing
adopted.drop_if: beneficiary takes in PM T5 turn negative over the 14 forward nights

paused.statement: The ownership tiebreak in T5 draft rankings (less drafted first within about 2 points): the PM T5 rule's (2: less drafted), adopted 2026-11-04, and the same habit in AM.
paused.evidence: Costs points in both windows: AM T5 ownership-order takes -4.2 per take (112 pairs, 80% range -5.2 to -2.6), PM -6.6 (84 pairs, -9.4 to -2.3).
paused.status: paused, under contest test: the contest side tests whether its leverage pays in money terms. Its use in swap ordering is decided by step 7's backtest.
